title: Create the Gapminder dataset
text:
# Import necessary libraries
import pandas as pd
from gapminder import gapminder

# Rename 'lifeExp' to 'life_expectancy' and 'gdpPercap' to 'gdp_per_capita'
gapminder = gapminder.rename(columns={'lifeExp': 'life_expectancy',
                                      'pop': 'population_millions', 
                                      'gdpPercap': 'gdp_per_capita'})

# Convert population to millions
gapminder['population_millions'] = gapminder['population_millions'] / 1_000_000

# Create a new pandas DataFrame from the modified gapminder data
gapminder_df = pd.DataFrame(gapminder)

# Save the DataFrame as a CSV file
gapminder_df.to_csv('gapminder.csv', index=False)

# Print the first 3 rows of the DataFrame
print(gapminder_df.head(3))

title: Country Analysis
text:
This page shows changes in life expectancy, GDP per capita, and population over time for the United States

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

country_name = "United States"
c = df[df["country"] == country_name].sort_values("year")

plt.figure()
plt.plot(c["year"], c["life_expectancy"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Life Expectancy")
plt.title(f"Life Expectancy Over Time: {country_name}")
plt.show()

plt.figure()
plt.plot(c["year"], c["gdp_per_capita"])
plt.yscale("log")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("GDP per Capita (log scale)")
plt.title(f"GDP per Capita Over Time: {country_name}")
plt.show()

plt.figure()
plt.plot(c["year"], c["population_millions"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Population (millions)")
plt.title(f"Population Over Time: {country_name}")
plt.show()

title: Life Expectancy and GDP per Capita
text:
This page shows how life expectancy and GDP per capita change over time across countries.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

plt.figure()
plt.scatter(df["gdp_per_capita"], df["life_expectancy"])
plt.xscale("log")
plt.xlabel("GDP per Capita (log scale)")
plt.ylabel("Life Expectancy")
plt.title("Life Expectancy vs GDP per Capita (All Years)")
plt.show()









# Relationship over time (average across countries each year)
yearly = df.groupby("year")[["gdp_per_capita","life_expectancy"]].mean().reset_index()

plt.figure()
plt.plot(yearly["year"], yearly["life_expectancy"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Average Life Expectancy")
plt.title("Average Life Expectancy Over Time")
plt.show()

plt.figure()
plt.plot(yearly["year"], yearly["gdp_per_capita"])
plt.yscale("log")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Average GDP per Capita (log scale)")
plt.title("Average GDP per Capita Over Time")
plt.show()

title: Life Expectancy and Population
text:
This page analyzes the relationship between life expectancy and population.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

plt.figure()
plt.scatter(df["population_millions"], df["life_expectancy"])
plt.xlabel("Population (millions)")
plt.ylabel("Life Expectancy")
plt.title("Life Expectancy vs Population (All Years)")
plt.show()









# Trend over time: average population and life expectancy by year
yearly = df.groupby("year")[["population_millions","life_expectancy"]].mean().reset_index()

plt.figure()
plt.plot(yearly["year"], yearly["life_expectancy"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Average Life Expectancy")
plt.title("Average Life Expectancy Over Time")
plt.show()

plt.figure()
plt.plot(yearly["year"], yearly["population_millions"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Average Population (millions)")
plt.title("Average Population Over Time")
plt.show()
